Color & Contrast

12 steps per ramp, equal OKLCH lightness across hues at every step. Fourteen ramps on the wheel — the six primaries/secondaries plus the in-betweens scarlet (red-orange), tangerine (yellow-orange), lime (yellow-green), cyan, violet (blue-purple) and magenta, plus neutral. Each hue ships in three saturation families — muted, regular, bold. Swatches below show the light-mode value set; dark mode swaps value sets on the same step numbers.

Brand themes = a primary + a secondary hue

A brand theme keeps neutral surfaces and takes its accents from a pair of ramps: the primary carries --accent-*, the secondary carries --secondary-*, the focus ring and the accent border. Single-hue themes get a neutral secondary so --secondary-* always resolves. Every secondary pairing is contrast-walked against the surfaces it actually sits on — including the tonal page and media.
